verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own marketing states that Ubuntu Pro Desktop provides up to 15 years of security coverage and is free for personal use, so the extended-coverage capability belongs to the product. However, the pack never documents how a user actually enables or attaches it on an existing installation. missing for 10: documented steps for enabling Ubuntu Pro/extended coverage on an installation, detail on which packages or releases are covered, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can enable extended years of security update coverage on my installation

citations.quote: Get up to 15 years of security coverage and benefit from enterprise-grade security, management tooling, and extended support for developers and organisations. Ubuntu Pro Desktop is free for personal use
